instructions.name: buy
docs: Spends up to `quote_in` (fee included) for at least `min_tokens_out`. The buy
that crosses the graduation threshold is clipped and pays only for what it gets.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The launch's own quote token: whatever its curve was created with, which
stays fixed even if the config's quote changes for later launches.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Creates a token and its curve. The creator gets nothing up front; buying is
the only way to hold the token, on the same terms for everyone.

accounts.name: mint
docs: A fresh keypair the client generates, so every launch has its own address.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The default quote (config.quote_mint), or an approved pair's token.

accounts.name: quote_pair
docs: Present to pair the coin with an approved token other than the default.
Its address is checked in create_launch (no seeds here, so clients that
leave it out get None rather than an auto-filled, nonexistent PDA).

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Permissionless once the curve is complete: creates the AMM pool at the
curve's final price, deposits, burns the LP tokens and the leftover tokens.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: pays rent for the pool accounts.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The launch's own quote token: whatever its curve was created with, which
stays fixed even if the config's quote changes for later launches.

instructions.name: graduate_raydium
docs: Same as `graduate`, into a Raydium CPMM pool on the caller's chosen fee tier
(trade fee at most 1%). The caller pays Raydium's creation fee and the pool's
rent; the graduator PDA signs as the pool creator, burns all the LP and
refunds every other lamport to the caller.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: pays Raydium's pool-creation fee and the pool's rent.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The launch's own quote token: whatever its curve was created with, which
stays fixed even if the config's quote changes for later launches.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup, gated on the program's upgrade authority so nobody can
front-run the configuration after deploy.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sells exactly `tokens_in` for at least `min_quote_out` (after the fee).

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The launch's own quote token: whatever its curve was created with, which
stays fixed even if the config's quote changes for later launches.

instructions.name: set_pair
docs: Approves (or updates, or disables) a quote token creators can pair a coin
with, with curve parameters in that token's units.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency switch: while paused, no new launches, buys, sells or graduations.

instructions.name: set_quote
docs: Switches the quote token for future launches, with curve parameters in
that token's units. Launches already created keep their own quote token.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Changes curve parameters for future launches. Existing launches keep theirs.

errors.name: BadMetadata
errors.msg: Name 1-32, symbol 1-10, uri up to 200 characters

errors.name: Complete
errors.msg: The curve is complete; trade on the pool

errors.name: NotComplete
errors.msg: The curve is not complete or already graduated

errors.name: BadFeeTier
errors.msg: Not a usable Raydium fee tier (creation disabled or trade fee over 1%)

errors.name: PairNotAllowed
errors.msg: That quote token isn't an approved pair

fields.name: curve_supply
docs: Tokens sellable through the curve; the rest are reserved for the pool.
